One of the best rifles to ever grace the planet. Biased against your enemies. Treat it with the respect it deserves.

Category: Super Luxury • Fabrication: DV29 - 10,000eb - 1 Month

Class: Iconic EQ Assault Rifle • Skill: Shoulder Arms • Range: Battle Rifle

Damage: 5d6 • Capacity: 18 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: No

Slots: N/A • Attachments: Biometric Lock, Power Rebuild, TUp (Does not require Subdermal Grip or Interface Plugs) Smartgun Link • Mods: None

Special Features: Despite being Iconic, this weapon can load Non-Basic Ammunition. When fired in Single Shot, this weapon expends 3 rounds in a burst. This weapon will not fire if there are less than 3 rounds in the magazine. Whenever this weapon would ablate armor, it ablates 1 additional SP (2 SP Normal / 3 SP Armor-Piercing).

When using this weapon to make an Aimed Shot, it deals 1d6 additional damage (6d6). The first time this weapon rolls for damage during combat, 5s count as 6s for the purposes of incurring Critical Injuries.

While the user is in the Seriously or Mortally Wounded Wound State, this weapon overclocks itself. While overclocked, the user gets an additional +1 bonus to all Attack Checks with this weapon, and when rolling for this weapon’s damage, any damage die that result in 1 are re-rolled until they result in a higher value.

Finally, during a Round in which this weapon’s magazine is fully depleted, the user can roll 1d6 against their LUCK, needing to get under their current — not total — LUCK pool. On success, half of this weapon’s magazine (9 Rounds) is instantly refilled for free. Guess there were some spares in there.

Fabrication: DV29 - 10,000eb - 1 Month
Range: Battle Rifle
Pre-installed: Biometric Lock, Power Rebuild, TUp (Does not require Subdermal Grip or Interface Plugs) Smartgun Link (effects already included in these stats)

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).
  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Super Luxury benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
